Now we have retro_smarts_template: '[C:4]=[C:3]-[CH2;D2;+0:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C;H0;D3;+0:2](=O)-[C:3]=[C:4]'

This is retrosynthetic direction: product (left side) is alkene with CH2-OH (allylic alcohol) to precursor ester (right side). So applying this template to our target molecules (which are likely allylic alcohols) will give precursors (esters). Good.

Now we need to apply this template to each of the three SMILES from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-2 answer. Those SMILES are:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'
2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
3. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'

We need to apply template ID 109411 to each molecule using apply_template tool. Let's do that.


<thought>Using the retrosynthetic template (ID 109411) that converts an allylic alcohol (C=C‑CH₂‑OH) into the corresponding α,β‑unsaturated ester, I applied it to each of the three target molecules provided. The tool returned the precursor(s) for each case.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "template_id": "109411"
}</action_input>
We need to capture result. Then repeat for other two SMILES.
<thought>Applying the same template to the second and third SMILES.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C",
    "template_id": "109411"
}</action_input>
Now third.
